stages.mythic: The long diagonal stone bridge, the paved deck, the fortified gate tower at each end, the lanterns and the running footprints. Remove all figures, the banners and every bit of grey mist. Go much further: the whole span humps up into one colossal central arch, higher than both gate towers, the deck climbing to a vertiginous crown of stone, the piers tall and sheer standing on rocky banks with dark slate-blue water below. From the crown of the arch a thin waterfall of pale blue light falls straight down into the water, strong by day and night, and the running footprints blaze pale blue up the whole deck, each one crisp and separate. Taller gate towers, lit windows, big lanterns along the parapet. The old cairn and milestone at the entry, worn boots on it. Long humpback silhouette along the long side of the footprint, nothing wider than today's ground.
